facts.value: The loader does not reset shared status on entry; its first sequence relies on static zero initialization, and the callback alone resets it on result -4. idTmp points into the current invocation's automatic idTmpBuf, whereas bb2Buf and the command block have static lifetime. Submission return values are ignored, and publication is gated only by drive status becoming zero, not by checking callback phase or validated boot metadata. The saved arena-high value is unused and is not restored.
facts.rationale: Adds useful lifecycle and completion-precondition limitations absent from the existing normal-path descriptions.

evidence.why: Shows all status writes, automatic versus static storage, unchecked requests, polling guard and arena-high handling.
